intent: Rebuild the currents ladder against Mediabase Active Rock and Mediabase Alternative airplay (both week of Jul 19-25 2026), reading each record on the chart its format lives on. A1 becomes the top five of each chart. 16 of the 17 entries to currents are recalls of already-owned charting records from W/ZN/Rx/X — this was a recall problem, not an acquisition problem. Composite-chart positions are used only as an entry signal for N, never to promote or drop. PD decisions applied: option 3 on the AAA-leaning recalls (Sam Fender and Myles Smith retained, Noah Kahan and Dominic Fike declined), Three Days Grace held in A1. B arrivals are routed to subcat 1, which becomes the single B pool; subcat 5 (B2) is retired indefinitely and emptied by the companion changeset 2026-08-02-b-consolidation.
